purpose: evidence for the v1->v2 freeze tolerance remediation (handbook 22.1, pre-scoring; zero outcomes exist)
smoke_scope: ETHUSDT 2026-05 (31 days) vs V16 panel, frozen v1 tolerances
v1_result: 2 tolerance FAILs on otherwise EXACT reconciliation (trade_count/first_ts/last_ts exact 31/31; last/high/low_price exact float equality 31/31)
root_cause: v1 tolerances were derived from per-hour CSV rounding bounds ONLY, omitting double-precision accumulation-order noise (V16 sums ~1M rows in row order; V17 sums 24 hourly parts) - noise is signed-random, ~N x ulp(running sum)/2 bounded, 100x the rounding term; additionally the rel tolerance term is meaningless for near-zero-magnitude fields (interarrival_mean_s ~0.05 s makes rel 1e-8 an effective exact-equality gate)
not_a_data_bug_because: every exact field (counts/timestamps/price selections) matched exactly on all 31 days; every failing diff is 5+ orders below any real defect signature (polarity flip O(1), hour-bucketing off-by-one O(day/24) on counts which are exact)
